neighbours.label: A copula linking an abstract subject to a characterising predicate ('The X of the Y is characteristic/due to/the key'), vs auxiliary be in progressive, passive or weather clauses
fire: In this disease, the symmetry of the swelling is typical and helps the diagnosis.
Coaches agree that defensive discipline will be the deciding factor on Sunday.
The rapid onset of the symptoms is thought to be due to a toxin.
For many critics, the brevity of the novel is its greatest strength.
The slow growth of the tumour is characteristic of this type of cancer.
Experts say the scarcity of water will be the main obstacle to expansion.
The stiffness of the joints in the morning is a common sign of arthritis.
Researchers suspect the decline of the bees is linked to pesticide use.
quiet: In this ward, the nurse is checking the swelling on each patient.
Coaches agree that the team will be travelling on Sunday.
The parcel was delivered to the wrong address on Tuesday.
For many years, my grandmother is said to have lived alone.
The old dog is sleeping under the kitchen table.
Experts say the bridge will be closed for repairs next month.
In the morning it is often foggy near the river.
Researchers were invited to visit the farm in June.

predictions: Fire items 0.3-0.7 on ' is' / ' be'; near misses under 0.2.
notes: Card: ' be' x16, ' is' x12 after long abstract subjects ('The transience of the lesions is characteristic'); logit effect promotes sufficient/significant/correct/due/beneficial. Probe: 'transience of the rash is characteristic' 0.665, 'will be the keys' 0.575, 'thought to be due' 0.414, 'is what saved' 0.207; 'She is running' 0.013, 'It is raining' 0.130, 'was born' 0.007. 'Keeping ... was the key' only 0.082.
